title.narrative: Diocese of Marsabit Drought Relief Project

description.narrative:
This is a 3 month emergency intervention which will contribute to alleviate the suffering of the hunger stricken communities as a result of the impact of the current drought in Greater Marsabit. This is the second consecutive year of severe drought in the area. The situation has recently worsened even further due to the total failure of the long rains (March-May 2009).
Marsabit is one of the regions in Kenya which has not experienced expected rains during the short rainy season between October and December 2009.
The activities in this proposal include the following:
a) Supplementary feeding program targeting 1,500 under five and 950 pregnant and lactating women. The beneficiaries will be accessed through five health centres in North Horr, Maikona, Kargi, Liyangallani and Diriba Gombo. UNIMX and Oil supplementary food will be distributed once a month at 100% food ratio since the expected rains did not fall and the situation remains an emergency situation. Monthly MUAC data will be collected from children under five to determine the nutrition/health condition.
b) Purchase and distribution of essential medicine will be done through the same health clinics to ensure that targeted beneficiaries nutrition condition is not affected by health conditions. In particular medicine will concentrate on addressing diarrhoea diseases and cholera which are common in the area.
c) Water sanitation and hygiene promotion for 20,000 individuals will also be done aimed at helping the population change negative hygiene practices. This will be done through disseminating key hygiene messages and hygiene promotions campaigns in the same health centres targeted above plus 10 schools. In the schools, child to child hygiene promotion will be done.
